subject: HelioHealth pilot: 2-week runway ask & packaging options
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <pshah@heliohealth.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: sales@heliohealth.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 2-week pilot runway + packaging options

Hi Markus,

Quick note — the execs asked whether we can extend the current pilot by two weeks so our clinical team can finish a second evaluation pass. Attached is a short usage summary from our side (HelioHealth_Pilot_Usage_Summary.xlsx) showing token consumption and peak concurrency.

We have two internal preferences and would like your recommendation: 1) a small, timeboxed token add-on (flat Sprint Pack) so we don't change contract terms; or 2) a short-term seat/bucket approach (temporary dedicated capacity hours for two weeks) if that gives more predictable latency and isolation.

Key constraints: finance needs a one-line invoice (no modifications to the master agreement if possible) and security asks that audit/log retention be extended for the pilot window. Can you outline options and rough costs by EOD tomorrow? We have an executive sync on Monday morning.

Thanks,
Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Product Integrations
HelioHealth, Inc.

--
Attachment: HelioHealth_Pilot_Usage_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pshah@heliohealth.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 17:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot runway + packaging options

Thanks for the context and the usage summary, Priyanka — that's helpful. Two straightforward ways we can handle this without touching the MA:

1) Sprint Pack (recommended if you want simplicity)
   - Fixed token bucket: +200k prompt+completion tokens, usable over 14 days
   - One-time invoice, no contract amendment
   - Price: $12,500 (includes 10% pilot-support discount)
   - Pros: simple invoice, predictable cost; Cons: no dedicated capacity guarantees

2) Timeboxed Seat/Bucket (recommended if you need isolation/latency)
   - Temporary reserved capacity: 2 seats (shared pool) + 24/7 burst credits for peak windows
   - Hourly/seat billing converted to a 2-week fixed invoice; includes priority routing
   - Price estimate: ~$18,000 (includes setup & priority routing)
   - Pros: predictable latency; Cons: higher cost, requires short config change on our side

If you can confirm which path you prefer, Jordan will send the exact invoice and DocuSign link; Monica will help with audit/log retention and ensure we capture the success metrics for the extension.

Looping Jordan and Monica in — Jordan, want to add anything on the pricing side or a quick alternative? Monica, can you confirm whether we can extend audit logs retention for the two-week window and how we'll surface that to Helio?

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pshah@heliohealth.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 18:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot runway + packaging options

Priyanka — thanks for the note. Pricing quick-adds for a 14-day runway (all prices shown are one-time charges, net of typical pilot discounts):

- Option A (Sprint Pack): 200k tokens — $12,500 (10% pilot discount). Deliverable: immediate top-up, invoice-only, no DocuSign amendment required.
- Option B (Seat+Burst): 2 seats reserved for 14 days — $18,000 (includes setup and 48 hours of burst credits). If you need more burst credits, extra block of 24 hours is $2,500.
- Option C (Hybrid): 100k token Sprint Pack + 1 seat reserved for 7 days — $11,500. Useful if you only need limited isolation during peak demos.

If HelioHealth needs a faster sign path, we can issue an invoice and consider the DocuSign addendum optional; however, Finance sometimes requests the DocuSign route. I can prepare a DocuSign envelope (proposal + invoice) — link will be ready in the next hour once you confirm Option A or B.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HELI-9876

Let me know and I'll send the formal offer + invoice.

—Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pshah@heliohealth.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot runway + packaging options

Hi Priyanka — quick operational notes from CS side:

- We can extend audit log retention for the pilot by 30 days beyond the extension window; I'll attach a short addendum to the pilot scope to confirm.
- For the Seat+Burst option, we'll provision a temporary route that pins traffic to dedicated GPU lanes during your demo windows; please share the target demo windows so we can align capacity.
- Success metrics: suggest we lock these two checks for the extension — (1) end-to-end latency < 350ms P95 for API calls during demo windows, (2) throughput to support at least 12 concurrent users without throttling.

If you pick Option A (Sprint Pack), we can still increase log retention but won't be able to guarantee dedicated capacity.

Attaching the pilot offer (Redwood_HelioHealth_Pilot_Offer_v2.pdf) with the two options called out and an audit-log addendum.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Redwood_HelioHealth_Pilot_Offer_v2.pdf (PDF, 96KB)
From: Priyanka Shah <pshah@heliohealth.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week pilot runway + packaging options

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. We want to proceed with Option A (Sprint Pack: 200k tokens, $12,500). Please:

1) Issue a one-line invoice addressed to HelioHealth, Inc. (we will route to Finance).
2) Include the audit-log retention addendum in the DocuSign envelope (Finance wants that in writing).

Jordan — once the DocuSign/invoice is ready, I will get sign-off and route for payment; target is EOD Monday. Appreciate the quick help here.

Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Product Integrations
HelioHealth, Inc.
